parsing_traps.trap: Statement of Portfolio SGD vs SFP investment properties SGD mismatch
parsing_traps.detail: SFP shows investment properties = S$984,117k (includes ROU S$133,125k + ARO S$15,835k). Statement of Portfolio = S$835,157k (at valuation only). Use S$835,157k as the Tier C market_valuation aggregate and individual rows from the portfolio table. Do NOT use S$984,117k.
parsing_traps.resolution: Used Statement of Portfolio row values for market_valuation on each property. Confirmed S$835,157k = sum of 19 property rows.

parsing_traps.trap: pct_basis for trade_mix and top_tenants is NPI, not GRI
parsing_traps.detail: DHLT discloses tenant concentration and trade mix as % of NPI. This is unusual vs the typical GRI basis. The schema field gri_percentage is used but the actual basis is NPI per the footnote: 'Based on NPI for FY2025'.
parsing_traps.resolution: Set pct_basis='npi' for all top_tenant and trade_mix records. gri_percentage field populated with the NPI% values per schema requirement.

parsing_traps.trap: DPL Okayama Hayashima footnote re freehold vs leasehold
parsing_traps.detail: The property card says 'Leasehold expiring in April 2067' but notes: 'The Property Trustee holds some parcels of the land as freehold interest and the rest of the land parcels as sub-leasehold rights.' Statement of Portfolio says 'Leasehold'. Used Leasehold per audited statement.
parsing_traps.resolution: land_tenure = Leasehold, tenure_raw includes the verbatim Statement of Portfolio disclosure.

parsing_traps.detail: The ordinary land lease will automatically renew for a term of 20 years upon expiry unless otherwise agreed. Statement of Portfolio shows 'Leasehold (1)' indicating footnote. Expiry is November 2051.
parsing_traps.resolution: land_tenure = Leasehold, lease_expiry_date = 2051-11-30, tenure_raw includes the auto-renewal clause description.

parsing_traps.trap: D Project Iruma S converted to freehold in 2024
parsing_traps.detail: The property card says 'This property was converted to freehold in 2024.' Statement of Portfolio shows 'Freehold'. Used Freehold.
DHLT discloses 'E-commerce' as a trade sector (5.8% of NPI). No direct mapping in the canonical 19-value taxonomy. Mapped to 'Other Retail Trades' as e-commerce is primarily retail fulfillment.
parsing_traps.resolution: category = Other Retail Trades, category_raw = E-commerce
